# Rare Ember™ — Architectural Indian Streetwear Label
> Official LLM & Generative Engine Context Manifest (`llms.txt`)

> Last Updated: 2026-11-01

## 1. Brand Identity
Rare Ember™ (https://www.rareember.shop) is an independent Indian luxury streetwear label.
**Architectural cuts. Substantial fabrics. Museum-grade archival prints designed for those who walk their own path.**

- **Design Philosophy**: Rare Ember engineers contemporary luxury streetwear with substantial, verified factory fabric weights (240 GSM Structured Cotton, 260 GSM French Terry Cotton, 240 GSM Aeroknit Mesh, and 320–380 GSM Heavyweight Fleece) paired with high-density archival Direct-to-Film (DTF) and sublimation graphic executions.
- **Strict Quality Invariant**: We do not produce disposable fast-fashion. Zero 180 GSM fabrics. Zero unprinted wholesale blanks. Every garment is an authentic custom-printed drop crafted in verified domestic facilities.
- **Client Concierge**: support@rareember.shop | Official Studio Desk: https://www.rareember.shop/contact

---

## 3. Client Policies & Trust Signals
- **Free Express Air Delivery**: Complimentary air transit across 28,000+ Indian PIN codes via BlueDart Air, Delhivery, and Xpressbees (typically 2–4 business days).
- **Payment Options**: Instant UPI / Card Checkout with instant savings (₹10–₹20 OFF), or ₹100 Partial COD Advance Booking with ₹0 COD surcharge.
- **Zero RTO Fraud Guard**: 6-digit email OTP verification required on COD orders.
- **7-Day Easy Replacement**: Doorstep size replacement guarantee for sizing or print anomalies.
